description: This PHP source file, displayMgr.php, contains functions related to report generation and display in the TestLink testing platform. It includes capabilities for initializing report parameters, generating email reports, displaying various report formats, and setting HTTP headers for report download or display.

methods.name: initArgsForReports
methods.description: Initializes and validates report-related arguments, manages access rights, and prepares parameters for report generation based on request input and configuration.

methods.name: generateHtmlEmail
methods.description: Generates an HTML email report using Smarty templates, configures email parameters, and sends the email. Returns status information.

methods.name: displayReport
methods.description: Handles the display or download of various report formats, including HTML, PDF, Excel, and email formats. Calls other functions to generate content and set appropriate HTTP headers.

methods.name: flushHttpHeader
methods.description: Outputs HTTP headers to instruct the browser on how to handle the report (display inline or download as attachment), based on document format and kind.
